name: High Ridge Shopping Center
summary: High Ridge Shopping Center is North Stamford's premier community retail destination, conveniently located off exit 35 of the Merritt Parkway. Anchored by Trader Joe's and featuring over 25 diverse tenants including DSW, Starbucks, and essential services, the center provides a comprehensive shopping experience for the surrounding affluent residential communities.
demographics: High Ridge Shopping Center serves the affluent North Stamford community and surrounding Fairfield County areas, attracting middle to upper-middle income households with median incomes significantly above the national average. The primary trade area draws from established residential neighborhoods with a mix of families, young professionals, and retirees who value convenience and quality. Shoppers are typically educated, health-conscious consumers who frequent specialty retailers like Trader Joe's and seek everyday services alongside dining options. The center's location near the Merritt Parkway provides easy access for commuters and residents from nearby towns including Greenwich and New Canaan.
description: High Ridge Shopping Center stands as the premier retail destination in North Stamford, Connecticut, strategically positioned on High Ridge Road at exit 35 of the Merritt Parkway. This well-established community shopping center has become a cornerstone of daily life for North Stamford residents, offering an impressive mix of national retailers, specialty shops, and essential services all in one convenient location. Anchored by the highly popular Trader Joe's grocery store, the center features over 25 diverse tenants including DSW Designer Shoe Warehouse, Starbucks, Cold Stone Creamery, and Boston Market, providing shoppers with everything from fresh-baked goods at Cobs Bread to smoothies at Robeks. The center also serves as a community hub with professional services including Stamford Pharmacy, The UPS Store, AAA, AT&T, and even a Stamford Police substation, ensuring both convenience and security for visitors. With ample parking, regular community events, and a tenant mix that balances shopping, dining, and services, High Ridge Shopping Center has earned its reputation as North Stamford's go-to destination for everyday needs and specialty shopping alike.
